observations.title: Adjust sender detection for formatted chat
observations.player_action: If a server's formatting prevents sender detection, inspect the Heuristic only option in the settings.
observations.outcome: Heuristic detection can recover portraits but can also assign the wrong head to a message.
conditions: Cloth Config exposes settings; the mod otherwise uses defaults.
